data.title: iOS Platform Support (v1.1+)
data.goalStatement: Extends the proven Android flow to iOS by implementing the platform switch's iOS branch over idb + simctl: simulator and physical-device discovery, live mirroring, screenshot and view-hierarchy capture, and the two iOS-specific error cards — simulator-not-booted ('Boot simulator' / 'Choose another') and device-not-trusted ("I've tapped Trust — retry" / 'Use simulator'). Reuses F-1's shell, F-4/F-5's annotation and measure surfaces, F-7's MCP handoff and F-9's Verify engine behind a platform abstraction, so only the device-adapter layer and the iOS error states are new. Why: deliberately deferred out of v1 (AS-5) so the complete Android loop ships first; it is the obvious parity follow-up once that loop is validated.

sources.summary: PRD feature F-10 iOS Platform Support: priority could, phase PH-2, estimate L. Contains FR-25, NFR-5/8/9/10, AC-31, SC-14, US-14 — all carried verbatim. Depends on F-2, F-3, F-9 (merged).

Verified survey of F-1..F-9 merged state. Key finding: PRD's claim 'only device-adapter + error states are new' is half true. Interfaces are neutral, but platform abstraction is missing at repository/domain layer. DeviceRepository has no platform param, Koin binds one unqualified instance per interface, adb hardcoded in argv builders, ToolKind/DeviceCommand/HostCommand are closed sets. F-10 is extraction + new iOS actual, not new actual alone. Error cards architecture ready, hierarchy model mostly neutral (iOS can degrade to empty on v1), ProcessRunner reusable.

Measured on macOS 25.1: xcrun simctl present (Xcode 26.3, iOS 17.5 + 18.1 runtimes), idb and idb_companion both installed. No simulator booted. Cannot test physical device-not-trusted without real untrusted iPhone.
Design prototype with Mirror/Annotate/Verify/History surfaces. iOS error cards (simulator-not-booted, device-not-trusted) recorded as deferred but already drawn.

codeReferences.note: Domain interface: observeDiscovery, mirror, dumpHierarchy, detectTools, bootEmulator, restartAdbServer, setAdbPath. Must add platform param threading.
Repository: poll(), listDevicesEscalating(), healDaemon(), killThenStart(). Unconditionally reaches for adbHostSource; must dispatch by platform.
Single Koin seam for device sources. Currently one unqualified binding per interface. Must widen to qualified Android + iOS bindings.
Argv builder: hardcodes adb -s selector. Must support simctl -u and idb --udid variants.
Closed enum: Adb, Idb. Missing xcrun/simctl kind. KDoc warns widening must be visible API change.
Desktop toolbar platform segmented control (:370-382). Hardcodes PLATFORM_SOURCES list; iOS picker card has enabled=platform==Android.
Renders errorCard() BEFORE stage when (:124-128). Platform-blind errorCard drives shadowing trap: iOS selected on no-adb host shows Android card.
Closed enum: ToolMissing, NoDevice, PollFailed, MultipleDevices. KDoc records err-sim, err-trust as deferred. Must add SimulatorNotBooted, DeviceNotTrusted.
Currently: Found(physical, emulators). Must add iOS-specific variants for simulator-not-booted, device-not-trusted states.
Interface: frames(DeviceId): Flow<MirrorFrame>, stats: StateFlow<TransportStats>. Already neutral; iOS impl will use xcrun simctl io screenshot or idb screenshot.
Current transport: single-flight loop, trimToPngSignature, PNG IHDR read, adaptive delay. Reusable verbatim if executor speaks screenshot tooling.
Interface: run(DeviceId, DeviceCommand): ByteArray. Neutral; iOS impls will map DeviceCommand.Screenshot/UiAutomatorDump to xcrun/idb equivalents or throw.

existingSolutions.summary: Android device adapter (F-2, F-3) — DeviceRepository + five datasource interfaces + closed DeviceCommand/HostCommand sets. Neutral measure/verify/diff toolkit (F-9). Shell reuses F-1's RectifyWindow. Annotation surface F-4/F-5. All ready to be wrapped by platform abstraction.
Error card projection (MirrorErrorCard, MirrorErrorStage, DiscoveryErrorProjection) — already structured for platform-specific cards but currently platform-blind.
Device picker UI (DevicePickerPanel, MirrorRow, PickerPlatform) — already multi-device aware, NFR-8 keyboard nav already wired, only picker-card enabled state needs Android→platform check.

glossary.definition: Facebook's iOS Development Bridge; command-line tool for iOS simulator/device control. Installed on this host at ~/.local/bin/idb.
xcrun simctl (Xcode's Simulator Control); command-line tool for Simulator control. Part of Xcode 26.3 on this host.
Daemon backing idb; must be running for idb to communicate with physical devices. Present on this host.
Dispatch seam at repository or datasource level that selects Android (adb) vs iOS (idb/simctl) implementations based on selected PlatformModel. Currently missing; F-10 must extract it.
iOS security state: physical device has not been tapped to trust the developer certificate. User must tap Trust on the device, then retry. AC-31 error card state.
iOS simulator is installed but not running. User can boot it on-demand via error card action, or choose another device. AC-31 error card state.
Closed enum of error states in device discovery: ToolMissing, NoDevice, PollFailed, MultipleDevices. Will add SimulatorNotBooted, DeviceNotTrusted.
State model for device discovery: currently Found(physical, emulators) for Android. Must add iOS variants for simulator/device states and error conditions.
Closed enum of device-side commands: Screenshot, UiAutomatorDump, etc. KDoc says widening must be visible API change. iOS will map to simctl/idb equivalents or reuse existing.
Closed enum of host-side commands for tool management: ListDevices, StartServer, KillServer, etc. KDoc says widening must be visible API change. iOS may need simctl-specific hosts.
Closed enum: currently Adb, Idb. Missing xcrun/simctl variant. KDoc says widening must be visible API change.
Koin DI binding with a `named()` qualifier, e.g. `single { Android impl } bind Interface with named('android')`. Currently F-10 has only unqualified bindings.
iOS Accessibility (AX) tree returned by `idb ui describe-all`; analogous to Android's uiautomator XML dump. Needs parsing to HierarchyNodeModel.

ambiguities: SCOPE: Platform abstraction extraction — qualified Koin bindings + threading `platform: PlatformModel` through DeviceRepository methods (bigger diff, cleaner API shape), versus a dispatching decorator over `StateFlow<PlatformModel>` (smaller diff, but less explicit). Recon costs both; Clarify should nail which one.

SHADOWING BUG: MirrorStageContent computes errorCard() BEFORE the stage when, and errorCard() is platform-blind while the Android poll keeps running. Picking iOS on a no-adb machine shows Android 'no device' card instead of iOS error. Any iOS error state must enter through errorCard() projection or be shadowed. How to solve: make errorCard() platform-aware, or inject DiscoveryModel variants that are already iOS-specific?

MIRRORING MECHANISM: Poll xcrun simctl io <udid> screenshot --type=png / idb screenshot (reuses ScreencapMirrorTransport + ProcessRunner unchanged), versus idb video-stream (higher fps, but needs streaming ProcessRunner entry point + H.264/MJPEG decode that decodeToImageBitmap cannot do). Recon covers both; Clarify should decide.

HIERARCHY RAWDUMP: idb ui describe-all returns AX JSON, not uiautomator XML. HierarchySnapshotModel/HierarchyNodeModel are neutral, measure+verify stack are neutral. But rawDump is documented as verbatim uiautomator stdout and hierarchyXml field is literally named XML. Today attachedHierarchyXml is Android-gated so iOS degrades to '' for free. Decide: carry AX JSON in v1, or ship iOS with no hierarchy and defer to v1.1?

JSON PARSING: data-device-api has zero dependencies beyond :data-core and no serialization plugin. Repo precedent is hand-rolled parsers. Hand-roll an AX JSON reader, or add kotlinx-serialization-json (in catalog, unused there)?
PHYSICAL DEVICE: AC-31's device-not-trusted half needs a real untrusted iPhone. This environment has none — expect it fake-driven via a test DiscoveryModel. Flag coverage honestly in test plan.

CLOSED COMMAND SETS: DeviceCommand/HostCommand/ToolKind are deliberately closed with KDoc saying widening must be visible API change. No simctl/xcrun ToolKind exists. Widening these is the first breaking change; decision should be explicit.

PRIORITY & PHASE: Spec is priority=could, phase=PH-2 (only non-must in this PRD). How far to take it: full parity (discovery + mirroring + hierarchy + error cards), or discovery + error cards + mirroring with hierarchy deferred to v1.1?
